snippet.title: 7 Days To Think About It - Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing "7 Days To Think About It"! 🥳

A short spot the difference psychological horror game. 
Your friends invite you to hang out tonight - you have 7 days to think about it. 📼

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828980/7_Days_To_Think_About_It/
